title: Quality-of-Transmission Estimation in Quantum Networks: Compute, Simulate, or Learn?
abstract: arXiv:2610.23827v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Future quantum networks will rely on control-plane decisions such as routing, scheduling, entanglement provisioning, purification, and memory allocation. Each decision depends on a timely and reliable estimate of the quality of the entanglement that a candidate path can deliver, with end-to-end fidelity as a central metric. Inspired by the optical-networking experience with quality-of-transmission (QoT) estimation, this article asks when a quantum controller should compute fidelity analytically, simulate it, or learn a surrogate model. The optical analogy is useful but incomplete: optical QoT estimation often predicts a scalar transmission margin, whereas quantum QoT estimation must account for probabilistic entanglement generation, random memory waiting times, decoherence, state consumption, and measurement constraints that can make fidelity a stochastic target. We propose a compute/simulate/learn framework for quantum QoT estimation

translated_title: 量子网络中的传输质量估计：计算、仿真还是学习？
translated_abstract: 未来的量子网络将依赖于控制平面的各项决策，如路由、调度、纠缠供给、纯化和内存分配。每一项决策都依赖于对候选路径所能提供的纠缠质量的及时且可靠的估计，其中端到端保真度是核心指标。受光网络中传输质量（QoT）估计经验的启发，本文探讨了量子控制器何时应该通过解析方法计算保真度、通过仿真获得保真度，还是通过学习建立代理模型。这种光网络的类比是有用的但不完整的：光QoT估计通常预测一个标量传输裕度，而量子QoT估计必须考虑概率性的纠缠生成、随机的内存等待时间、退相干、量子态消耗以及测量约束等因素，这些因素会使保真度成为一个随机目标。我们提出了一个用于量子QoT估计的计算/仿真/学习框架。
tldr: 本文受光网络QoT估计经验启发，提出了一个量子网络传输质量估计的“计算/仿真/学习”决策框架，用于指导量子控制器在何种情况下应解析计算、仿真或通过学习获得端到端纠缠保真度。
en_tdlr: Inspired by optical-networking QoT estimation experience, this article proposes a compute/simulate/learn framework for quality-of-transmission estimation in quantum networks, guiding when a quantum controller should analytically compute, simulate, or learn a surrogate model for end-to-end entanglement fidelity.
